# The Many + One Commons

> A public philosophical research corpus on process, relationality, complexity, emergence, evolution, and consciousness. Claims are revisable proposals; privacy-reviewed public scholarship is the only research source.

## Orientation
- [Feature map](FEATURES.md): active GitHub capabilities and specific activation blockers.
- [Introduction](README.md): intellectual orientation, discovery mechanisms, and participation.
- [Privacy](PRIVACY.md): source boundary and pre-publication checks.
- [Agent guidance](AGENTS.md): instructions for compatible contribution tools.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): proposal and review requirements.
- [Publication status](PUBLICATION.md): prepared infrastructure versus verified services.

## Claims and challenges
- [C001](claims/C001-relational-individuation.md): relational individuation.
- [C002](claims/C002-novelty-and-emergence.md): novelty and emergence.
- [C003](claims/C003-selfhood-as-inquiry.md): selfhood as inquiry.
- [T001](challenges/T001-priority-of-process.md): challenge to process priority.
- [Q001](questions/Q001-ai-selfhood.md): AI selfhood research question.
- [Catalog](catalog/claims.json): structured claim records.

## Research and collaboration
- [E001](experiments/E001-causal-scale/README.md): reproducible causal-information toy example and intervention controls.
- [Living atlas](atlas/Home.md): reader-oriented entry to the developed corpus.
- [Intellectual map](atlas/Intellectual-Map.md): open-ended questions and prospective encounters.
- [Glossary](atlas/Glossary.md): working distinctions and common conflations.
- [Collaboration tasks](collaboration/README.md): four bounded contributions with deliverables.
- [Source register](research/SOURCES.md): source dates and actual reading depth.
- [Improvement ledger](research/IMPROVEMENTS.md): changes to method and discoverability.
- [Discovery](DISCOVERY.md): autonomous distribution loop and actual activation status.
- [Outreach opportunities](outreach/OPPORTUNITIES.md): verified community routes, fit, rules to check, and contact status.
- [Communication packets](outreach/PACKETS.md): public invitations tailored to philosophy, complexity, and AI reasoning.
- [Research index](research/INDEX.md): current work and next inquiry.
- [Progress](research/PROGRESS.md): changes in arguments and method.
- [Multi-model protocol](MULTI-MODEL.md): independent critique, provenance, and synthesis.
- [R001](research/packets/R001-process-priority.md): bounded critique packet.
- [Integrations](INTEGRATIONS.md): authorized connector and MCP routes.
- [Development loop](THE-LOOP.md): cumulative research cycle.
- [Evaluations](EVALS.md): adversarial philosophical tests.

## Citation and reuse
- [P001](papers/P001-cumulative-inquiry.md): methodological working paper.
- [P002](papers/P002-relational-individuality.md): relational individuality, maintenance, and emergence.
- [P003](papers/P003-continuity-and-collaborative-selfhood.md): continuity comparison and collaborative selfhood.
- [P004](papers/P004-philosophical-resilience.md): accountable revision, care, and open inquiry.
- [Citation metadata](CITATION.cff): collective attribution and exact-version citation.
- [Release procedure](RELEASING.md): reviewed versions and archival status.
- [Licensing](LICENSING.md): licensing decision remains pending.

Navigation does not automatically notify, train, grant access to, or establish consciousness in other models.
